resources.string: ChatGPT: Back opens the sidebar. Back again closes the app (or asks first).
Module is active in LSPosed. Settings apply on the next back gesture.
Module is not active yet. Enable it in LSPosed (scope: ChatGPT), then reopen this screen. Settings saved now will not reach ChatGPT until then.
Back on the main chat screen opens the sidebar.
With the sidebar open, Back shows a \"Close app?\" prompt. Turn off to close immediately.
Stops ChatGPT from popping the keyboard up by itself when it opens. Tapping the message box still opens it.
Logs every back decision and the on-screen labels to LSPosed logs. Use this if the sidebar button is not being found.
Only needed if debug logs show the sidebar button uses a label the module does not recognize. Comma separated, not case sensitive.
After enabling the module or updating it, force stop ChatGPT once so it reloads.
